symptom: NaN loss step 1-10
likely_cause: LR too high; exploding gradients
diagnostic: Print param norms and gradient norms per step
fix: Lower LR 10x; add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_

symptom: NaN loss after epoch 3-5
likely_cause: LR divergence spike; warmup misconfigured
diagnostic: Plot LR schedule; check scheduler.get_last_lr()
fix: Add LR warmup; use CosineAnnealingLR or OneCycleLR

symptom: Loss stuck at random baseline
likely_cause: LR too low; wrong optimizer; label encoding bug
diagnostic: Compare loss to log(num_classes) for classification
fix: Raise LR 10x; verify labels are 0-indexed integers

symptom: Epoch 1 loss 100x worse than epoch 2
likely_cause: Per-epoch scheduler zeroing warmup; step called before first batch
diagnostic: Print lr at step 0 and step 1
fix: Move scheduler.step() inside batch loop (per-batch not per-epoch)

symptom: OOM on GPU
likely_cause: Batch too large; graph retained between batches; model too large
diagnostic: nvidia-smi dmon; profile with torch.profiler
fix: Halve batch size; add gradient_accumulation_steps; del loss after backward

symptom: Dataloader bottleneck
likely_cause: num_workers=0; slow disk I/O; no prefetch
diagnostic: GPU utilization < 50% during training; profile dataloader time
fix: num_workers = min(8 os.cpu_count()); prefetch_factor=2; pin_memory=True

symptom: Non-reproducible results
likely_cause: Random seed not fixed in all libs; non-deterministic CUDA ops
diagnostic: Run twice; compare val metric — should be within 1e-4
fix: torch.manual_seed(42); np.random.seed(42); random.seed(42); CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8

symptom: Validation metric much worse than train
likely_cause: Overfitting; too few val samples; data augmentation too aggressive
diagnostic: Plot train vs val curves; check split sizes
fix: Add dropout; increase weight decay; reduce augmentation; more data

symptom: Dataset leakage
likely_cause: Shuffle before split; ID overlap between splits
diagnostic: Check ID intersection: set(train_ids) & set(val_ids)
fix: Split first (by ID or time) then shuffle each split independently

symptom: Model loads but different forward pass
likely_cause: Different checkpoint vs current arch; stale weights
diagnostic: Compare model.state_dict() keys to checkpoint keys
fix: Load with strict=False; check arch version

symptom: MLflow run not found
likely_cause: Wrong tracking URI; experiment name mismatch
diagnostic: mlflow.get_tracking_uri(); mlflow experiments list
fix: Set MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI before importing mlflow

symptom: Slow convergence on new dataset
likely_cause: Learning rate from old dataset not optimal; different data distribution
diagnostic: Compare gradient norms to successful run on old data
fix: Run LR finder; use warmup; validate data normalization matches training

symptom: Training stuck after epoch N with no error
likely_cause: Dataloader deadlock; eval/checkpoint step hanging; silent network wait
diagnostic: Per-epoch timestamped logs; py-spy dump the process
fix: Add per-step logging with timestamps; timeout wrappers on eval and upload steps; run scripts not notebooks for long trainings

symptom: Run finished but tracker shows RUNNING
likely_cause: Process killed before end_run; no finally block
diagnostic: Compare run status vs training log tail
fix: Wrap in try/finally mlflow.end_run(); set_terminated stale runs explicitly

symptom: Metrics/artifacts missing from a finished run
likely_cause: Upload failed mid-run; wrong tracking URI mid-process
diagnostic: List run artifacts; check MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI at runtime
fix: Upload missing artifacts to the SAME run; verify artifact list after every run

symptom: Analysis reports wrong or empty metrics
likely_cause: Metric names guessed instead of read from code
diagnostic: Grep log_metric calls in the training script
fix: Use exact metric-name strings from the training code; document the list in project docs

symptom: Early stopping fired while metric still improving
likely_cause: Patience too small for metric noise
diagnostic: Plot metric curve vs stopping epoch
fix: Increase patience; log stopping reason; rerun before drawing conclusions

symptom: Val metrics too good to be true
likely_cause: Preprocessing artifact (vocab/scaler/encoder) fit on full data
diagnostic: Check what data each fitted artifact saw
fix: Fit every artifact on train split only; vals/test used exclusively for evaluation

symptom: Modeling starts but dataset fitness is unknown
likely_cause: Prediction unit target horizon or point-in-time feature availability is undefined
diagnostic: Write the data contract; profile duplicates missingness time coverage labels and target proxies
fix: Block training until data-readiness gates pass; produce a versioned data-quality and labeling plan

symptom: Random split looks strong but deployment performance is weak
likely_cause: Repeated entities or future information cross the split boundary
diagnostic: Measure entity overlap and compare feature timestamps with each prediction cutoff
fix: Use time- or group-aware splitting that matches deployment; persist split membership

symptom: Complex model appears useful without beating a simple baseline
likely_cause: No trivial rules-based or statistical baseline was measured
diagnostic: Evaluate the candidate and baseline on the same frozen split and decision metric
fix: Keep the simpler approach unless the candidate wins on aggregate and important slices

symptom: Experiment notebook mostly exercises an endpoint or client
likely_cause: Integration plumbing hides the model or decision logic being studied
diagnostic: List notebook cells that inspect intermediate logic versus transport setup
fix: Import and call the core logic directly; move endpoint verification to a separate integration smoke

symptom: Generated labels inflate metrics
likely_cause: Agent- or model-generated labels leaked into evaluation or were accepted without review
diagnostic: Audit label provenance and overlap with the locked holdout
fix: Tag generated labels; validate independently; exclude them from the locked holdout
